dialogues.jp: あ〜。かったるい。
dialogues.en: Ahh~, so troublesome.
dialogues.text: Ahh~, so troublesome.

dialogues.jp:
世間はゴールデンウィークだってのに、何で学
校は暦どおりなんだろう。
dialogues.en:
It's the Golden Week all around, why's the school still
open...
dialogues.text:
It's the Golden Week all around, why's the school still
open...

dialogues.jp: 非常に休みたい。
dialogues.en: It should be a time for rest.
dialogues.text: It should be a time for rest.

dialogues.jp:
教師だって、たまにはサラリーマンみたいに連
休取りたいんじゃないかな。
dialogues.en:
Teachers seem to be real salarymen, they don't get
continuous holidays like us.
dialogues.text:
Teachers seem to be real salarymen, they don't get
continuous holidays like us.

dialogues.jp: 労働条件、良くした方がいいんじゃないのか？
dialogues.en: Are those working conditions really satisfactory for them?
dialogues.text: Are those working conditions really satisfactory for them?

dialogues.jp:
俺はコーヒーを入れながら、一人でぶつぶつ文
句を言う。
dialogues.en: I sipped at my coffee while aimlessly grumbling to myself.
dialogues.text: I sipped at my coffee while aimlessly grumbling to myself.

dialogues.jp: でも、遅れるわけにはいかない。
dialogues.en: But I can't be late now.
dialogues.text: But I can't be late now.

dialogues.jp: 今日も環が待っててくれるから。
dialogues.en: I'd be waiting for Tamaki today.
dialogues.text: I'd be waiting for Tamaki today.

dialogues.jp: 朝が楽しみなんて、一体どういうことだろう。
dialogues.en: Haha, I'm being cheerful in the morning...
dialogues.text: Haha, I'm being cheerful in the morning...

dialogues.jp: 俺らしくない。
dialogues.en: Totally unlike me.
dialogues.text: Totally unlike me.

dialogues.jp: ……惚れてるよな。
dialogues.en: ...I'm really in love, huh.
dialogues.text: ...I'm really in love, huh.

dialogues.jp: 一人で赤面しながら、テーブルに着く。
dialogues.en: Blushing to myself, I got up from the table.
dialogues.text: Blushing to myself, I got up from the table.

dialogues.speaker: Newscaster
dialogues.jp: 『では、次のニュースです』
dialogues.en: "On the next topic,"
dialogues.text: "On the next topic,"

dialogues.jp: 俺は何気なくテレビを見る。
dialogues.en: I absentmindedly turned my attention to the television.
dialogues.text: I absentmindedly turned my attention to the television.

dialogues.speaker: Newscaster
dialogues.jp:
『枯れないことで有名な、初音島の桜が、今日
　未明枯れているのを発見されました』
dialogues.en:
"The famous Hatsu-Nejima Unwithering Sakura was sighted this
morning to have faded."
dialogues.text:
"The famous Hatsu-Nejima Unwithering Sakura was sighted this
morning to have faded."

dialogues.jp: え？
dialogues.en: Ehh??@
dialogues.text: Ehh??@

dialogues.jp: 俺は思わず身を乗り出して、テレビを見る。
dialogues.en: My full attention was on the television now.
dialogues.text: My full attention was on the television now.

dialogues.jp: ブラウン管には、枯れた桜が映し出されている。
dialogues.en:
The brownness of the withered sakura was clearly shown on
the television.
dialogues.text:
The brownness of the withered sakura was clearly shown on
the television.

dialogues.jp: 「あらららら……」
dialogues.en: "Oh geez..."
dialogues.text: "Oh geez..."

dialogues.jp: いったい、どういうことだ？
dialogues.en: Are they for real?
dialogues.text: Are they for real?

dialogues.jp: テレビでも、原因は分かってないらしい。
dialogues.en: They're saying that they don't know the reason why either...
dialogues.text: They're saying that they don't know the reason why either...

dialogues.jp:
いつも咲いているのが当たり前だと思うと、枯
れたことが信じられない。
dialogues.en:
It seemed natural to me that they'd always be blooming... I
couldn't believe they had withered.
dialogues.text:
It seemed natural to me that they'd always be blooming... I
couldn't believe they had withered.

dialogues.jp: 半分信じたくない気持ちもあり。
dialogues.en: Or maybe half of it was that I didn't want to believe.
dialogues.text: Or maybe half of it was that I didn't want to believe.

dialogues.jp:
鬱陶しいと思ったこともあったけど、やっぱり
あるのと無いのとでは、ある方がいいに決まっ
てる。
dialogues.en:
While it's depressing, I also can't do anything about it
now...
dialogues.text:
While it's depressing, I also can't do anything about it
now...

dialogues.jp: 後で、見に行ってみるか。
dialogues.en: I'd go take a look at it later.
dialogues.text: I'd go take a look at it later.

dialogues.jp: ◆枯れない桜◆
dialogues.en: ◆Withering Sakura?◆
dialogues.text: ◆Withering Sakura?◆

dialogues.jp:
ニュースで、枯れない桜が枯れた、と伝えてい
た。
dialogues.en:
The news reported that the Unwithering Sakura had withered
away.
dialogues.text:
The news reported that the Unwithering Sakura had withered
away.

dialogues.jp: いったい、どうしたことだろうか……。
dialogues.en: I wonder what's happened...
dialogues.text: I wonder what's happened...
